project: MoerEngine Vulkan Interrupt Sync Event Refactor
goal: Remove interrupt serial-based sync tracking and replace it with ordered GraphEvent-based sync boundaries. Sync() must wait only for submissions enqueued before that Sync request, while preserving the distinction between ERHISyncDepth::RHI and ERHISyncDepth::Present.

how_they_apply_here: 不能保留 serial 方案再叠一层 event 方案做兼容，必须直接收敛到单一语义。
不能为了内部实现方便引入 per-queue tail 数组或新的 prefix-compression 状态机，当前公开语义只需要 RHI tail 和 Present tail。
完成标准必须依赖 RHI translate tests，而不是靠 WaitIdle 或人工观察判断。
测试时只关注 validation error 和功能失败，不用为 warning 做额外复杂度。
测试入口和文档命令统一使用 powershell 脚本。

design_constraints.title: Sync boundary is ordered by SubmissionThread, not InterruptThread
design_constraints.detail: Sync() only covers submissions that are already ahead of the sync request in SubmissionThread order. InterruptThread must not infer the boundary by serials, live tails, or task queue scanning.

design_constraints.title: No live-tail waiting from caller threads
design_constraints.detail: Caller threads must never wait directly on a mutable tail object. Sync requests need a frozen GraphEvent snapshot created when SubmissionThread reaches that request.

design_constraints.title: Only semantic tails are allowed
design_constraints.detail: Do not maintain StaticArray<EQueueType::Num> queue tails for sync semantics. The public API only exposes ERHISyncDepth::RHI and ERHISyncDepth::Present, so the runtime should keep only semantic aggregation state: rhi_tail and present_tail.

design_constraints.title: InterruptThread only completes task-local events
design_constraints.detail: InterruptThread is responsible for real host-side completion work and then unlocking the task-local GraphEventRef associated with that completion. It must not own global sync sequencing state.

design_constraints.title: SubmissionThread owns aggregation
design_constraints.detail: SubmissionThread creates or updates the current rhi_tail and present_tail in submission order, and creates frozen sync events for Sync() and Flush().

design_constraints.title: RHI and Present semantics must remain observable
design_constraints.detail: ERHISyncDepth::RHI waits for all pre-sync RHI interrupt completions. ERHISyncDepth::Present waits for the same RHI completions plus all pre-sync present interrupt completions.

design_constraints.title: Flush must remain stronger than Sync(RHI)
design_constraints.detail: Flush() still needs to drain SubmissionThread and then wait for the frozen completion event representing all work that Flush is defined to cover.

non_goals: Do not redesign GPU dependency assembly in SubmissionAssemble. wait_events and submission-to-submission ordering are already established there.
Do not add a compatibility layer that supports both serial sync and event sync at the same time.
Do not change the public ERHISyncDepth enum or widen the public sync API in this refactor.

why_current_design_is_wrong: The serial mechanism does not define true submission ordering; SubmissionThread and submission assembly already do that.
InterruptThread currently owns a prefix-completion protocol that is more complex than the exposed sync semantics require.
The current implementation couples sync semantics to a global monotonically increasing counter instead of explicit completion events.
why_plain_tail_waiting_is_also_wrong: If Sync() waits on a live tail directly, later submissions can be folded into the same wait and violate the 'only before this Sync' contract.
A frozen sync event must be created at the ordered point where SubmissionThread reaches the sync request.

target_design.overview: Each interrupt completion task gets its own GraphEventRef. SubmissionThread aggregates these task-local events into semantic tails: rhi_tail for queue completions and present_tail for present completions. Sync() and Flush() become ordered requests that are consumed by SubmissionThread, which snapshots the current semantic tails into a frozen GraphEventRef and returns that event to the caller.

components.name: task_local_interrupt_event
components.purpose: Represents completion of one interrupt task after allocator/callback/signal/profiler/present cleanup is done.

components.name: rhi_tail
components.purpose: Aggregates all queue completion events that are logically part of ERHISyncDepth::RHI.

components.name: present_tail
components.purpose: Aggregates all present completion events that are additionally required by ERHISyncDepth::Present.

components.name: frozen_sync_event
components.purpose: A one-shot GraphEventRef produced when SubmissionThread consumes a sync request and snapshots the current semantic tails.

semantic_rules: Queue completion tasks update only rhi_tail.
Present completion tasks update only present_tail.
Sync(RHI) returns a frozen event that depends on the current rhi_tail snapshot.
Sync(Present) returns a frozen event that depends on the current rhi_tail snapshot plus the current present_tail snapshot.
If a requested tail does not exist yet, the returned sync event should complete immediately.

checkpoints.title: Lock the sync semantics before touching implementation
checkpoints.problem: The current code mixes three ideas: GPU dependency order, interrupt completion order, and Sync boundary order.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: The implementation document clearly states that Sync boundaries are defined only by SubmissionThread order.
The document explicitly rejects interrupt serial prefix tracking and direct live-tail waiting.
tasks: Write down the contract for ERHISyncDepth::RHI and ERHISyncDepth::Present in terms of interrupt completion events.
Write down that Sync requests must enter SubmissionThread as ordered requests, not be resolved from caller thread snapshots.
Write down that InterruptThread has no global ordering responsibility beyond finishing task-local events.

checkpoints.title: Introduce task-local interrupt completion events
checkpoints.problem: Interrupt tasks currently report completion only through serial progression.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Each queue/copy/present interrupt task carries a GraphEventRef completion handle.
ProcessTask(...) unlocks only that task's event after all host-visible completion work is done.
tasks: Add a GraphEventRef field to queue, copy, and present completion task payloads.
Remove task-local dependence on serial fields for completion reporting.
Ensure shutdown drains or unlocks any still-pending task-local events so shutdown cannot deadlock waiting callers.

checkpoints.title: Move sync aggregation into SubmissionThread
checkpoints.problem: The current Sync() path drains SubmissionThread and then asks InterruptRuntime to resolve sync from global serial state.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: SubmissionRuntime owns mutable semantic aggregation state: rhi_tail and present_tail.
SubmissionThread updates those tails only when a submit or present completion has actually been scheduled into InterruptRuntime.
tasks: Add runtime state for rhi_tail and present_tail inside VulkanSubmissionRuntime.
When a queue completion task is enqueued into InterruptRuntime, create a task-local event and fold it into rhi_tail.
When a present completion task is enqueued into InterruptRuntime, create a task-local event and fold it into present_tail.
Keep the aggregation single-purpose; do not add per-queue tail arrays unless a new public sync semantic requires them.

checkpoints.title: Turn Sync and Flush into ordered requests
checkpoints.problem: A caller-thread read of mutable state cannot safely express 'all submissions before this Sync'.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Sync() enters SubmissionThread as a control request and receives a frozen GraphEventRef snapshot.
Flush() drains submission work and then waits on a frozen completion event instead of WaitForSerial(GetEnqueuedSerial()).
tasks: Add a SubmissionBatch control path or equivalent ordered request path for Sync/Flush.
When SubmissionThread consumes a Sync(RHI) request, produce a frozen event depending on the current rhi_tail snapshot.
When SubmissionThread consumes a Sync(Present) request, produce a frozen event depending on the current rhi_tail and present_tail snapshots.
Return an already-complete event when the relevant snapshot is empty.

checkpoints.title: Delete the serial-based protocol completely
checkpoints.problem: Leaving the serial path in place would violate Rule_Codex and keep two competing sync semantics alive.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: All interrupt serial fields and helper methods are removed.
InterruptRuntime no longer contains pending_sync_requests, completed_serials, WaitForSerial(), or GetEnqueuedSerial().
tasks: Delete enqueued_interrupt_serial, completed_interrupt_serial, last_rhi_completion_serial, and last_present_completion_serial.
Delete NextInterruptSerial(), MarkInterruptSerialCompleted(), WaitForSerial(), and GetEnqueuedSerial().
Delete pending_sync_requests and completed_serials along with their shutdown handling.
Remove now-dead serial fields from task structs.

checkpoints.title: Verify behavior with RHI translate tests and no WaitIdle fallback
checkpoints.problem: The refactor changes sync semantics and can easily regress by waiting too much, waiting too little, or forgetting present completion.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: RHI translate tests pass for both Sync(RHI) and Sync(Present) paths.
Validation output has no new errors during the test run.
No implementation depends on VulkanDevice::WaitIdle() to make the tests pass.
tasks: Run the existing RHI translate test script in powershell after each critical checkpoint.
Check that present-focused test cases still pass and are not accidentally downgraded to RHI-only waiting.
Add a regression test if needed for 'Sync waits only for submissions before Sync'.

checkpoints.title: Remove SubmissionPresentContextManager as a redundant wrapper
checkpoints.problem: SubmissionPresentContextManager currently only wraps a queue-indexed array of SubmissionPresentContext with thin Get/Flush/Shutdown forwarding. It does not provide an independent lifecycle policy, routing abstraction, or reusable ownership boundary, so it adds an extra layer without adding semantic value.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: VulkanSubmissionRuntime owns present contexts directly instead of routing through SubmissionPresentContextManager.
Present context ownership and lifecycle are more explicit after the cleanup.
No behavior change is introduced to Sync, Flush, present completion, or shutdown semantics.
tasks: Move the queue-indexed present context storage from SubmissionPresentContextManager into VulkanSubmissionRuntime directly.
Inline the current Get/Flush/Shutdown forwarding logic into VulkanSubmissionRuntime.
Delete SubmissionPresentContextManager if no non-trivial policy remains after the move.
Re-run the RHI translate tests to verify the cleanup is purely structural.

execution_order: CP-01: Freeze the semantics and reject serial/live-tail designs.
CP-02: Give every interrupt task an explicit completion event.
CP-03: Let SubmissionThread own rhi_tail and present_tail aggregation.
CP-04: Convert Sync/Flush into ordered requests with frozen snapshot events.
CP-05: Remove the serial protocol completely.
CP-06: Validate the behavior through the existing RHI translate script and targeted regressions.
CP-07: After the main refactor is stable, remove SubmissionPresentContextManager as a non-semantic wrapper.

test_script.purpose: Build and run TestRHITranslate.exe, capture logs, print the log tail, and summarize failures for the Vulkan RHI multi-queue translate tests.
behavior_summary: Sources common.ps1 and initializes the test run via Initialize-TestRun.
Builds the TestRHITranslate target before running the executable.
Runs target/bin/<Config>/TestRHITranslate.exe and stores stdout/stderr in a per-run log file.
Prints the last 10 lines of the log for quick feedback.
On failure, extracts lines matching mismatch, failed, or [error].
how_to_use_for_this_refactor: Run after any checkpoint that changes Sync(), Flush(), SubmissionThread ordering, or InterruptThread completion behavior.
Treat new validation errors as regressions even if the executable exits successfully.
Do not substitute VulkanDevice::WaitIdle() or manual host waits as a pass condition.

acceptance_criteria: Sync(RHI) waits only for interrupt-visible RHI completion work that was already ahead of the sync request in SubmissionThread order.
Sync(Present) waits for the same RHI completion set plus present completion work already ahead of the sync request.
Submissions created after a Sync request are not folded into that Sync wait.
InterruptRuntime no longer owns any global serial or prefix-completion state.
testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 passes without relying on WaitIdle-based fallback behavior.

risks.title: Accidentally waiting on live mutable tails
risks.impact: Sync waits for work that was submitted after the Sync request.
risks.mitigation: Only create sync events inside SubmissionThread when the ordered request is consumed.

risks.title: Mixing GPU completion with interrupt completion
risks.impact: Sync can return before callbacks, allocator retirement, or profiler resolution have actually finished.
risks.mitigation: Task-local GraphEventRef must unlock only after ProcessTask(...) completes.

risks.title: Keeping the serial path as backup
risks.impact: Two conflicting sync systems remain in the code and semantic ownership stays unclear.
risks.mitigation: Delete the serial protocol completely in CP-05.

risks.title: Losing Present semantics during simplification
risks.mitigation: Keep present_tail as an independent semantic aggregation state and validate with present-focused tests.

risks.title: Mixing structural cleanup with semantic refactor too early
risks.impact: A redundant-wrapper cleanup can obscure whether a regression comes from sync semantics or from present-context ownership changes.
risks.mitigation: Keep SubmissionPresentContextManager removal as a post-stabilization checkpoint after the main sync/event refactor is already passing tests.
